On November 5, 2026, Louisiana-Pacific Corporation (the “Company”) announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend to common stockholders of $0.30 per share. The dividend will be payable December 4, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 20, 2026. The press release issued by the Company in connection with the dividend is included as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and incorporated into this Item 8.01 by reference.
